const r=await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import json,hashlib
x=json.load(open('.ai/task/repair-w41-20260927/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-r3a1.json'))
b=json.dumps(x['payload'],ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode()
print(hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),x['candidate_identity'])
print(json.dumps({'contract':'translation_contextual_v2','candidate_identity':x['candidate_identity'],'verdicts':[{'revision_key':k,'verdict':'OK'} for k in x['payload']['ordered_revision_keys']]},separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False))
PY",workdir:"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",sandbox_permissions:"require_escalated",justification:"Verify frozen candidate identity and format full ordered review response.",max_output_tokens:6000});text(r.output)
